lines: | **`benchmark/2026-10-02-white-vs-lit/`** | **White cluster vs lit, offline on real runs: 7 same-app lit/white pairs (11 runs, 4 lottery keys) + the U10.1T8 surface (16 white / 117 lit on their signing runs). Not one wall: M1 top Activity's window gets the empty Surface (2/16 vs 0/117, pairs 11/11 runs; deployed bridge 84695d62 publishes the cross-copy native window through one env slot, only the last-created session resolves), M2 full-screen WebView without a renderer (5/16 vs 1/117), M3 GLSurfaceView EGL IAE (3/16 vs 1/117), M4 no window session (termux, toutiao), 4 unexplained. Only Bonferroni-significant template: GL program linked in the app (9/16 vs 117/117, a symptom). Double copy, two sessions, Compose, AppCompat, trampoline, B10 themes do not separate. Predicted movers: M1 fix 2 white (noice, fd-uhabits) + 2 lottery stabilised; others 0 or wall-only.** |

- 2026-10-02 **白簇不是一堵墙,是四个机制 + 4 个分不开**(cc-t3,同 app 同态亮/白 7 对 11 次运行 + U10.1T8 16 白/117 亮,只用真实运行):M1 多窗口——顶层 Activity(app 最后向 SceneBoard 请求的 ability)的 VRI 拿到空 Surface(白 2/16、亮 0/117,成对 11/11 次全对;wikipedia/noice/fd-noice/fd-uhabits 的抽奖就是它);M2 整屏 WebView、我们没渲染器(5/16 vs 1/117,caniwebview 亮是因为 WebView 外有原生界面);M3 GLSurfaceView eglCreateWindowSurface IAE(3/16 vs 1/117);M4 没建窗口会话(termux、头条)。双拷贝/双会话/Compose/AppCompat/trampoline/B10 theme 都分不开;唯一过 Bonferroni 的模板是 app 里链接过 GL 程序(白 9/16、亮 117/117,只说明内容除背景外什么都没画)。e92a7a87a7『白是内容/渲染(N11h 双拷贝族)』后半句作废,『不是慢』仍成立。见 benchmark/2026-10-02-white-vs-lit/。

- 2026-10-02 **M1 的静态根:跨拷贝窗口查找是单槽环境变量**:部署 bridge 84695d62 的 createSession 用 `WESTLAKE_WINDOW_SESSION_ID_V1`/`WESTLAKE_NATIVE_WINDOW_PTR_V1` 两个进程环境变量发布原生窗口(oh_window_manager_client.cpp:96-103、:656-660),每建一个 session 覆写一次;compat shim 落到另一份 bridge(sessions_ 空)后走 readProcessWindowTarget,只认最后发布的 sessionId(:116-128)。两个窗口同时活着时先建的那个必拿空 Surface,顶层 Activity 先建就白。最小修=按 sessionId 分槽发布/读取(只改 bridge 一个文件,不动 namespace);预测白→亮 noice、fd-uhabits,wikipedia/fd-noice 抽奖变稳。判多窗口 app 要看**顶层** Activity 的窗口,不是『有窗口失败』(之前两条判别式就是看错了窗口)。

- 2026-10-02 run 级判定要取**承载签认的那次运行**:double-copy-universality/per-key.csv 的 run_dir 是首个签认窗(wikipedia 是窗1 白,签认 lit 来自窗5 r1);按 u10-1-t8-reference/sources.json 取。U8 61b 零变量重复(2026-10-01-u8-flaky-repeat)的 hilog 已不在(run_index files_gone),成对分析用 U5 probe、U7 noice、U10.1T8 wikipedia。
